research_question: 新 BankSim 输入上，在固定容量和固定模型配置下，历史的捕获增量是否依赖当前参照信息集？
methodology: 四信息集、两条共同预处理的树提升流程；仅 B1 验证选型，冻结配置后比较组件；新模拟基准，不是实际业务外部验证。

datasets.name: BankSim
datasets.selection_basis: 结构/来源/使用史与成本；无候选模型结果
datasets.independence: 用户声明从未使用并有有界本地检索；公开模拟数据
datasets.labels_access_before_protocol_freeze: no row-level label analysis; public aggregate counts already visible

features.source_id: 0-based exact CSV data ordinal, assigned before sorting
features.history_condition: t-w <= historical_step < t, same merchant; exclude entire current step
features.amount_representation: exact integer cents; nonfinite/more-than-two-decimal values fail validation
features.same_step_policy: emit features for all rows before updating state
features.test_history_updates: earlier unlabelled transactions allowed, including earlier test steps

preprocessing.numerical_missing: train median plus missing indicator; all-missing numeric train column fills 0
preprocessing.categorical_encoding: one-hot; train vocabulary; missing reserved token; unknown all zeros
preprocessing.constant_removal: train-constant columns only, shared deterministic rule
preprocessing.numerical_missing_indicators: all numeric columns, then apply train-constant removal rule
preprocessing.categorical_missing: empty string -> reserved token; check token conflict before release

tuning.estimand: component effects under one validation-selected fixed configuration per pipeline, not separately optimized cell performance
tuning.label_feasibility_gate: after protocol freeze, train and validation must each contain two classes; otherwise stop without moving split

fit_budget.reuse: selected B1 seed42 models only if identical inputs, preprocessing and full config

evaluation_metrics: H1 and D per pipeline (primary inference family)
cross-pipeline paired H0 and H1 differences (secondary)

ties: SHA256 of UTF8 banksim-capacity-v1| plus decimal source_row_id ascending
capacity.window: whole completed test window; not real-time daily budget

contrasts.seed_aggregation: evaluate each seed separately; mean effects; no score ensemble

statistics.bootstrap: non-circular moving blocks of whole ordered simulation steps
statistics.sequence_rule: draw ceil(54/L) uniform overlapping blocks with replacement, concatenate, truncate to 54 steps
statistics.pairing: same step sequence for all models, seeds, metrics, contrasts
statistics.no_positive_rule: TP defined as 0; Recall/AP undefined; report invalid counts and do not replenish
statistics.scope: conditional fitted models/window; local dependence assumptions; no exact nominal coverage claim

reporting.capacity_saturation: report ceiling, do not change primary capacity
reporting.positive: one external synthetic input under specified conditions only
reporting.inconsistent_pipelines: paired difference and limitations; no causal algorithm-family interpretation
reporting.invalid_test: retain split; report inability to evaluate

resources.walltime_estimate: unknown until first budgeted train/validation fits; no training in audit
resources.bootstrap_implementation: reuse pre-sorted score order and block multiplicities; compare against literal resampling on hand-built examples

implementation_gates: exact input member hash and schema
shared preprocessing fitted only on train
locked dependency versions and full effective model parameters
validation-selection lock before any test metrics

section_plans.Introduction: 明确参照信息集边界问题，承认已有组件/容量/模型比较先例

risks: simulation is not real-world external validation
B1 may not empirically be stronger
merchant identities may absorb signal but D is bundle-level effect
baseline-selected parameters do not characterize all tuned history models
full software/resource feasibility not yet verified
stop_conditions: after one complete trial do not automatically expand datasets or tune on test
completion_conditions: all 40 cells have valid results or explicit failure entries
paired replay and input reconstruction artifacts recorded
claim-to-evidence updated without replacing old baseline
fallback: 如果无法满足条件或只接受真实业务外部验证，保留条件性实证定位并转期刊匹配与投稿准备。
